### Changed

- *(ssetest)* Close a held stream between Reads without deadlock in [#1421](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1421) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(deps)* Update module github.com/giantswarm/mcp-oauth to v1.7.0 in [#1362](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1362) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update opentelemetry-go monorepo to v1.47.0 in [#1406](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1406) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(workflow)* Leave a skipped forEach iteration without an indexed result in [#1412](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1412) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(workflow)* Put a failed step's error on its own entry only in [#1414](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1414) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(alerts)* MusterMCPServerFlapping ignores a single outage burst in [#1417](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1417) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workflow)* A parallel group's Go error outranks an IsError sibling in [#1418](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1418) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(oauth)* Document that a session grant is the forwarded principal's in [#1419](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1419) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(test)* Hand muster serve its listeners as inherited fds in [#1422](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1422) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/compare/v5.37.1...v5.37.2-rc.9
